license_required.quote: A person may not engage in the business of money transmission or advertise, solicit, or hold itself out as providing money transmission unless the person is licensed under this chapter.

net_worth_structure.quote: A licensee shall maintain at all times a tangible net worth of the greater of $100,000 or 3% of total assets for the first $100 million, 2% of additional assets for $100 million to $1 billion, and 0.5% of additional assets for over $1 billion.

net_worth_min_usd.quote: (a) A licensee shall maintain at all times a tangible net worth of the greater of $100,000 or 3% of total assets for the first $100 million, 2% of additional assets for $100 million to $1 billion, and 0.5% of additional assets for over $1 billion.
